description: Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2277/36 of 27.04.2022
reasoning: This gazette content pertains specifically to the amendment of a notice about roads and narrow roads owned by the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha (a local government body). The core subject matter is the ownership and classification of local government property (roads), which falls under land and property-related matters as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While it involves a local government entity, the content does not concern government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities, so government types (1-3) do not apply. The notification is about property ownership records, making Land the appropriate classification.
